# Fixture provenance

Copied byte-for-byte from the scraper-generated record
`winisd_drivers/snapshot/datasheets/sb-acoustics/sb23nrxs45-4/driver.json` at winisd_drivers commit `b3667bb89`.

Its sensitivity is printed at 2.83 V / 1 m (the reading's `note` is `2.83V/1m`). This fixture regresses
QO962: the printed 2.83 V figure is kept and the engine works out the 1 W one.
